Hey, I remember this game. You make a simple phrase and translate it. Then translate it back to English to see how well the translator performs:

Source term: This was translated to [Language], then back to English.

Bulgarian: Това е преведена на български, а след това обратно към английски.
English Return: It has been translated into Bulgarian, and then back to English.

Czech: To bylo přeloženo do češtiny, a pak zpět do angličtiny.
English Return: It was translated into Czech, and then back into English.

Dutch: Dit is vertaald naar het Nederlands, dan terug naar het Engels.
English Return: This has been translated into Dutch, then back to English.

Indonesian: Hal ini diterjemahkan ke bahasa Indonesia, kemudian kembali ke Inggris.
English Return: This translated into Indonesian, then returned to England.

Polish: Ten został przetłumaczony na polski, a następnie z powrotem na angielski.
English Return: This has been translated into Polish, and then back to English.

Turkish: Bu daha sonra İngilizceye geri, Türk tercüme edilmiştir.
English Return: This then back to English, and Turkish translations.

...........Now the super fun part..........

Source Term: This was translated from English into all the languages listed above, then finally back to English.
Final Result: Finally back to England, then all of the above have been translated from English.
